selected_features: fastrand default; glam default std. These are the direct utils manifest defaults; whole-App optional serde/bytemuck feature unification is not tested.
rules: Before execution root canonical source must match source_after_sha256; an approved candidate origin is disclosed while central integration is pending.
Root copies template to a fresh independent runtime directory before any Cargo command.
Never run Cargo inside this frozen template; Cargo can rewrite lock/metadata even when source is fixed.
Use offline and locked first; if lock materialization is needed, only the runtime copy may change and the final lock/hash/package identities must be captured for independent review.
No old utils rlib or linked recovered crate is used; harness compiles exact source slices and actual pinned registry dependencies.
Package versions/source/checksums must equal these constraints; no dependency upgrade or network fetch is authorized by this artifact.
